description_zh: 查询座席详细信息列表
name: CloudQueryAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the queue. If a queue ID is provided, the operation returns all agent records in that queue
parameters.help_zh: 队列号；当qno不为空时，查询指定队列的所有座席记录
parameters.name: qno

parameters.help_en: A list of agent IDs, separated by commas. You can specify up to 500 agent IDs
parameters.help_zh: 多个座席号以英文逗号分隔 最多支持500个座席
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: The starting position for the query. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to `0`. Default value: `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始；正整数，大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: `1` to `1,000`. Default value: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 查询条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the agent is enabled. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是停用，1是启用
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the agent is online. Valid values: `0` (offline) and `1` (online)
parameters.help_zh: 是否在线；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是离线，1是在线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The sort order by creation time. Valid values: `0` (ascending order) and `1` (descending order)
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The type of address to return for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain name), `2` (private domain name), `3` (public IP), and `4` (private IP)
parameters.help_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
parameters.name: webrtc_url_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the creation time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the creation time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return information about the agent's bound queues. Valid values: `1` (returns queue information) and `0` (does not return queue information). Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回绑定座席的队列信息；0:不返回 1:需要返回 默认值:1
parameters.name: return_queue

parameters.help_en: The agent name to use as a filter. This parameter supports fuzzy matching by prefix and suffix
parameters.help_zh: 通过座席名称检索；取值说明：前后缀模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The agent comments to use as a filter. This parameter supports fuzzy matching by prefix
parameters.help_zh: 通过座席备注信息检索；取值说明：前缀模糊匹配
parameters.name: comment

A value of `OK` indicates a successful request.

请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

IsAsr.description_zh: 是否开启ASR转写：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启

IsOb.description_zh: 是否允许外呼，0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许

WebrtcUrlType.description_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址，0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP

Wrapup.description_en: The wrap-up time, in seconds. The default value is `10`

AnnouncePosition.description_en: Specifies the condition for announcing the caller's position in the queue. Valid values: `0` (Off), `1` (Announce when the position is greater than the value of `AnnouncePositionParam`), or `2` (Announce when the position is less than or equal to the value of `AnnouncePositionParam`)
AnnouncePosition.description_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
AnnouncePosition.title_en: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放

AnnouncePositionParam.description_zh: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2

AnnouncePositionYouarenext.title_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the queue

JoinEmpty.description_en: Specifies the agent states considered unavailable. A caller cannot join a queue if all agents are in one of the specified states. Valid values: `1` (busy), `2` (in a call), `4` (ringing), `8` (invalid), and `16` (wrap-up)
JoinEmpty.description_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理
JoinEmpty.title_en: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理

MaxLen.description_en: The maximum number of callers allowed in the queue. Valid values: 0 to 999. A value of `0` indicates no limit
MaxLen.description_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
MaxLen.title_en: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
MaxLen.title_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制

MemberTimeout.description_en: The time in seconds that a call rings for an agent before it is routed to the next agent. Valid values: 20 to 60. The default value is 25
MemberTimeout.description_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
MemberTimeout.title_en: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
MemberTimeout.title_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒

QueueTimeout.description_en: The maximum wait time for a caller in the queue, in seconds. Valid values: 5 to 600. The default value is 600
QueueTimeout.description_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒
QueueTimeout.title_en: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒
QueueTimeout.title_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒

Retry.description_en: The delay, in seconds, before the call is routed to the next agent if the current agent does not answer
Retry.description_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数

Retry.title_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数

SayAgentno.description_en: Specifies whether to announce the agent's ID. Valid values: `true` (Announce) and `false` (Do not announce)

ServiceLevel.description_en: The service level threshold, in seconds. Calls answered within this time meet the service level objective
ServiceLevel.description_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
ServiceLevel.title_en: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
ServiceLevel.title_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平

Strategy.description_en: The call routing strategy. Valid values: `rrordered` (skill-based priority), `rrmemory` (round-robin), `fewestcalls` (fewest calls), `random` (random), `linear` (linear), and `leastrecent` (longest idle time)
Strategy.description_zh: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间

VipSupport.description_en: Specifies whether VIP support is enabled for the queue. Valid values: `1` (Enabled) and `0` (Disabled)

Weight.description_en: The priority of the queue. Valid values: 1 to 10. The higher the value, the higher the priority
Weight.description_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
Weight.title_en: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
